title: SoroBeacon — Store, Replica Routing & API Latency
description: Database read pool distribution (primary vs replica), replica fallback rate, and HTTP route latency across API surfaces.

panels.title: Read Replica Routing Status
panels.description: 1 when a read replica is configured and active; 0 when all read-only queries route to the primary.

panels.title: Store Read Rate by Pool (primary vs replica)
panels.description: Good: when replica is enabled, read-only queries land on pool="replica".

panels.title: Replica Fallback Rate
panels.description: Good: 0 fallbacks/sec. A non-zero rate means the read replica is unreachable or timing out and traffic is falling back to primary.

panels.title: HTTP Request Latency by Route (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Good: p95 < 250ms across API routes. Rising latency on alert queries indicates partition scan pressure; see docs/operations/retention.md.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Status Code
panels.description: Good: 5xx rate at 0. Tracks request volume and error responses across API endpoints.
